rules.text: This separately versioned prospective policy is design-only. It authorizes no requests, admissions, scoring or owner acceptance; existing record/manifest/envelope schemas and checker decisions remain unchanged.

Fail closed before scheduling unless every applicable preflight field, substantive verification receipt, finite plan, affordable reservation and reviewed freeze binding is available and consistent. Nulls and synthetic labels cannot satisfy real preflight. Do not rewrite template null reasons.

Bind exact manifest and plan bytes and canonical settings by SHA256. Join each slot by record_id, case_id, pair_id, repetition_id and arm, and each attempt by slot_ref plus unique attempt_id and positive increasing attempt_order. Use explicit comparison per-arm repetition maps; never infer pairing from identifier strings or treat repetitions as retries.

Freeze a finite ordered slot list before requests: sorted case IDs, then comparisons sorted by the explicit (no-tool repetition_id, tool repetition_id, pair_id) tuple, then existing ascending SHA256(seed:pair_id:arm) arm order. Reject duplicate identities, ambiguous mappings, duplicate comparison keys or hash-order ties at preflight. Bind this exact materialized order in the prospective freeze receipt alongside the immutable plan hash; existing plan.slots remains an inventory, not an asserted dispatch order. Only one slot is dispatched at a time, once, after rechecking bindings and reservation; no reordering from outcomes and no speculative dispatch.

Automatic retries, replacement attempts, response reuse and selecting an attempt are forbidden. After any attempted slot, move to the next frozen slot only if no hard stop applies. A future retry-enabled variant requires its own predeclared independently reviewed policy and freeze, never retrospective reinterpretation.

Retain every original request, response, transcript, error and all required sidecar objects and attempts, including unsuccessful, unsolicited and invalid submissions, before interpretation. Preserve bytes, size, hash, location, producer/version, UTC and attempt identity; absent response differs from present zero bytes. Missing/corrupt evidence is not an absent response. Keep unrepresentable submissions in an immutable rejection/quarantine ledger; do not manufacture a valid envelope or response. Unknown costs remain null.

A synthetic structurally complete comparison requires valid envelope/linkage and exactly one retained attempt for each opposite-arm slot in its explicit mapping; both must be byte-bound legacy-valid complete successes with no errors, truncation, interruption, exhaustion or failed tool calls. Multiple attempts leave selection unresolved and yield zero for the affected comparison. Transport success, parseable output and structural completion give no semantic, fidelity or real-comparison credit. Actual completed/scored comparisons here are always zero.

With intact evidence and bindings, failed/interrupted/unsupported attempts or absent/empty/invalid-UTF8/malformed/legacy-invalid responses terminate that slot as ineligible, without retry. Preserve the subtype and continue the finite order unless an independent hard evidence/resource/settings failure applies. An incomplete outstanding request at a hard stop retains its original bytes and explicit missing evidence. Use interrupted in the envelope only when supported by the retained event; unknown is a quarantine diagnostic, never a new envelope outcome or success.

A proven byte-identical redelivery with the same attempt identity is one retained attempt and multiple immutable delivery records, never a second envelope row or a second charge without usage evidence. Proof covers the full original submission and evidence inventory plus trusted receipts establishing delivery-only duplication and no second provider execution; matching response text alone is insufficient. If this proof is unavailable, preserve both deliveries as unresolved, stop for hard evidence failure and award zero completion. Inconsistent reuse of an attempt identity is a hard identity/evidence failure: retain both deliveries, quarantine the conflicting submission, mark the slot unresolved and do not complete it. A distinct attempt identity is an extra attempt even if its response bytes match.

A distinct unsolicited attempt is retained and explicitly rejected by this scheduling policy, never selected. A valid representable extra stays in the existing envelope with attempt_selection unresolved; an invalid/unplanned submission stays in the rejection ledger with all raw bytes. The affected slot/comparison is unresolved/ineligible. During dispatch it triggers a hard evidence/policy stop; late arrivals after terminal state update the final audit and completion inventory without reopening dispatch or erasing the recorded operational terminal state.

Stop all further dispatch at the first hard evidence/resource failure: missing/corrupt required evidence, untrusted/unwritable retention, irreconcilable identity, missing usage needed for ceilings, isolation loss, unsupported required infrastructure, external interruption or an unsolicited new attempt. Preserve detected causes in event order and affected in-flight bytes; all later slots remain unstarted. No post-stop restart under this freeze. Ordinary unsupported answer outcomes with intact infrastructure follow R08.

Check manifest/plan/settings hashes, returned-model compatibility with frozen snapshot or disclosed window, inputs and reader/runner/scorer bindings before and after each dispatch. Predispatch drift stops without creating an attempt; postdispatch drift retains the attempt as ineligible and stops. Restoration does not permit continuation. A later plan needs a new reviewed freeze and keeps the failed plan visible.

Before each dispatch reserve the entire slot worst-case matched limits against the remaining frozen total token/time/call/quota ceilings and run window. Unavailable initial affordability blocks preflight; later insufficient reservation, exhausted request budget or ceiling stops dispatch. Preserve usage, cache/retry/queue/tool/probe ledgers and unpriced/null costs; charge all actual attempts, including unsolicited ones, when known, without authorizing overrun, new quota or spending. Unreconcilable resource evidence is a hard evidence failure, not zero usage.

Operational states are blocked_preflight, ready, running, finished_complete, finished_incomplete, stopped_hard_failure, stopped_settings_drift and stopped_budget. Terminal states never reopen dispatch. Exhausted finite order is finished_complete only when all planned comparisons structurally complete and audit is clear; otherwise finished_incomplete. An observed hard stop retains its stop state even on the last slot. Completion counts and final audit are separate from operational state, and late evidence can reduce counts without rewriting that history. Record all simultaneous causes; primary precedence is hard evidence failure, settings drift, then budget.

Report every planned slot and comparison, dispatched slots, all attempts and deliveries, retained but unplanned/rejected evidence, missing and unstarted slots, ineligible and unresolved slots, eligible structural comparisons and final audit. Missing means no retained attempt references that planned slot; unstarted means no authorized dispatch and may differ from missing. Never impute, discard unfavorable attempts or shrink planned coverage/required denominators. Preserve independent correctness and grounding D1-D4 denominator 4, extras/contradictions, and separate unavailable fidelity probes; structural and conditional estimates cannot establish completed real comparisons.

Reuse precision design unchanged: four paired development repetitions is only a pilot allocation; evaluation r stays null pending independently checked development variance/fit, accepted lineage groups, owner precision targets and verified quota. Candidates 2/4/8/16/32 do not choose a real count. Freeze pilot evidence/count/settings/ceiling/stopping before evaluation and never use evaluation gains for sizing or stopping. Retain separate correctness/grounding uncertainty, cluster preservation, planned-weight missing bounds and no interval below two complete independent lineages; no new target or threshold.

preflight.validation: Presence alone is insufficient: independently checked byte identities, permitted routing, trusted storage/usage/model/isolation receipts, accepted method revisions, parity, supported modalities, case inventories and finite affordable order must all agree. A field with a genuine not-applicable case needs a predeclared reviewed justification, not a silently cleared null. Any unmet applicable requirement blocks scheduling.

freeze_contract.identity_encoding: Manifest and plan hashes use exact original bytes. Canonical settings use UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii false, as in the pinned 0138 synthetic setting identity; future typed real settings require reviewed serialization and binding.
acyclic_sequence: Independently review/freeze the policy document bytes and record policy hash externally; it does not contain a hash of itself.

After required reviewed development pilots and owner records, fill a new manifest instance using existing fields; stopping_rule references this policy_id and hash, sampling_order references the finite proposed order, precision_cost_plan_revision pins precision evidence and revision. Leave the template and its null reasons unchanged.

Materialize explicit plan slots/comparisons from that manifest, with immutable manifest hash; derive the finite order using R04 and freeze a separate receipt binding policy hash, manifest hash, plan hash, canonical settings hash and full dispatch order. Existing plan slot inventory order is not an executed order claim.

Independently verify receipt identities/authority and budget reservations before any request. Refuse missing/null/mismatched values. Recheck gates per slot; no post-failure continuation or evaluation-driven change under the same freeze.

real_configuration.reason: No unavailable real configuration or approval is inferred from public synthetic values, loop aliases, startup diagnostics or this supplement.

state_model.slot_notes: Unresolved is always ineligible for completion. Missing/unstarted are separate inventory flags; a retained unsolicited attempt can make an unstarted slot present. In-flight is temporary; stop preserves its evidence and classification gaps explicitly, without inventing an attempt_event.
state_model.late_evidence: Operational terminal state/history is immutable; final audit and structural-completion inventory may worsen as late evidence arrives. Never reopen dispatch or select a replacement. Historical complete counts remain versioned, not erased.
state_model.stop_log: Earliest detected stop prevents all further dispatch. Retain all same-gate causes, using priority only to select the primary state; no success-based override.

integration_seam.location: Future reviewed runner admission/dispatch wrapper after existing manifest and explicit paired plan creation, before the first provider request; delivery retention before any legacy parsing; policy audit alongside unchanged record/envelope/grouping validation before comparison reporting.
integration_seam.inputs: Immutable manifest/plan/settings and external prospective freeze receipt with full order, identity mapping, budgets and trusted preflight evidence.
integration_seam.outputs: Append-only dispatch/stop/reservation/delivery/rejection ledgers referencing full existing identities and byte evidence; unchanged valid legacy records or null, unchanged synthetic envelope records where representable, separate policy audit and complete/missing/unstarted inventories.
integration_seam.duplicate_boundary: Same-attempt redelivery is recognized at ingestion only with complete identity/byte and no-second-execution proof; preserve every delivery externally and supply one unique attempt row. If duplicate rows are passed to the old checker, it continues to reject them. This proposal does not modify it.
